parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the DDoS attack event to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Settings for the number of interception logs to return on each page when you perform a paged query. Paging is used to return results.

parameters.name: ProtocolNumber
parameters.description: The network protocol number. This is a standard network protocol number.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the DDoS attack event to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
